title: Get Windows 11 Pro for $10.49: a one-time rate, no subscription
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: This lifetime Windows 11 Pro license runs cleanly via Parallels or Boot Camp on a Mac, for $10.49 (reg. $199.00) using code SAVE30 through August 25.

You don’t need a second computer to run Windows software, you just need a license, and this one costs less than a coffee run.

Windows 11 Pro is $10.49 for lifetime use instead of $199, and it installs directly through Parallels Desktop, VMware Fusion, or Boot Camp on your Mac, so Windows-only apps sit right alongside your Mac apps.

Built for Pro-level work

Pro brings the features Home leaves out: BitLocker encryption for locking down sensitive files, Hyper-V and Windows Sandbox for testing apps in an isolated environment, and Azure AD support for connecting to a business network.

You also get Copilot built into the taskbar for quick settings changes and file searches, Snap Layouts for real multitasking, and amped up security with biomentric login features.

For Mac owners running Parallels or VMware Fusion, this covers the Windows license without a monthly fee tacked onto an already-recurring app cost. Boot Camp users get full native performance on the Windows side, no virtualization overhead at all.

Get Windows 11 Pro for $10.49 (reg. $199.00) using code SAVE30 through August 25 at 11PM PT.
